sections.title: Stock on hand
sections.sql: select lot,product,location,batch,quantity,reserved,free,status,expires_on from stock_view where customer_id=$1 order by lot

name: pick-slip
title: Pick slip: supervisor release required
for_each: select id,name from orders where status='open'

name: charge-statement
title: Warehouse charge statement: check approval status

sections.title: Weekly charges
sections.sql: select r.name,r.week_ending,r.status,r.approved_by,l.currency,l.kind,l.units,l.rate_cents,l.amount_cents from charge_lines l join charge_runs r on r.id=l.run_id where l.customer_id=$1 order by r.week_ending,l.kind
sections.note: Internal charge statement, not a tax invoice. Storage is a week-end snapshot; handling covers seven calendar days.
